kind.description: Listy renders an array of items, following the Ant Design List API (grid, itemLayout, size, bordered, split, header, footer). Each dataSource element is rendered via itemTemplate, or as a child widget when it carries a resourceRefId. Named 'Listy' (antd's successor to the deprecated List) because k8s reserves the 'List' kind. Supersedes DataGrid.

grid.description: antd List grid layout (ListGridType); presence enables grid mode

gutter.description: Spacing between grid columns, in pixels. Mirrors antd List `grid.gutter`.

column.description: Number of columns at the default breakpoint. Mirrors antd List `grid.column`.

xs.description: Number of columns at the extra-small breakpoint. Mirrors antd List `grid.xs`.

sm.description: Number of columns at the small breakpoint. Mirrors antd List `grid.sm`.

md.description: Number of columns at the medium breakpoint. Mirrors antd List `grid.md`.

lg.description: Number of columns at the large breakpoint. Mirrors antd List `grid.lg`.

xl.description: Number of columns at the extra-large breakpoint. Mirrors antd List `grid.xl`.

xxl.description: Number of columns at the extra-extra-large breakpoint. Mirrors antd List `grid.xxl`.

hideWhenEmpty.description: When there are no items, render nothing (null) instead of the antd Empty 'No data' placeholder. Enables a server-driven conditional section: the RA emits items only when a condition holds (e.g. compositions count == 0), so the section appears/disappears with the data without any client-side logic.

header.description: antd List header (ReactNode in antd; string here)

footer.description: antd List footer (ReactNode in antd; string here)

pagination.description: antd List pagination (serializable subset); presence enables client-side paging of the delivered dataSource (e.g. the ~400-card Marketplace grid). Server-side facet/search filters (?extras) shrink the array BEFORE it reaches the widget, so paging composes with them: antd clamps the current page into the filtered range, and a single-page result hides the pager entirely (exception-only chrome). Absent = antd default (no pagination).

dataSource.description: antd List dataSource. Each element is a data object (rendered via itemTemplate) or { resourceRefId } (rendered as a child widget).

itemTemplate.description: serializable substitute for antd renderItem: maps a data element's fields to row slots ({dot.path}; {a|b} first-non-empty)

secondaryText.description: {dot.path} to the value shown opposite the primary text.

subPrimaryText.description: {dot.path} to the line beneath the primary text.

subSecondaryText.description: {dot.path} to the line beneath the secondary text.

description.description: longer body line (2-line clamp); only rendered by the card rowVariant (e.g. a catalog tile description)

cardCta.description: card-footer call-to-action cue (e.g. "Configure") shown footer-left when a card rowVariant is clickable (navigateTo); rendered as mono amber text + a sliding arrow (a navigation hint, not a button)

icon.description: {dot.path} to an icon name, or a literal name, shown at the row leading edge.

iconVariant.description: leading-indicator style: avatar (solid disc + glyph, default), tile (soft-tint rounded square + glyph), dot (small status dot + halo)

rowVariant.description: row layout: default (antd List.Item.Meta — avatar + stacked title/description) | tree (tight single-line mono Relations row: connector + status dot + primaryText + muted inline subPrimaryText + right-aligned colored secondaryText) | card (full antd Card tile — icon-tile + name + version badge (subPrimaryText) + category tag (secondaryText) + description + a footer of rowActions as visible buttons — the Marketplace catalog grid) | chip (compact navigable filter pill — primaryText label + optional count, solid/amber when the item's active flag is set — the data-driven Marketplace facet chips)

secondaryTextAsTag.description: render secondaryText as a soft-tint Tag pill (e.g. a category) instead of plain text

subPrimaryTextMono.description: render subPrimaryText as a small mono bordered pill (e.g. an event involvedObject Kind/name ref) instead of plain sub-text

navigateTo.description: per-item navigation target ({dot.path} template, e.g. {link}); when it resolves non-empty the row becomes clickable and navigates there (SPA route)

value.description: {dot.path} to the value the colour is chosen from.

map.description: Maps a resolved value to a colour token, for example `Ready` to green.

default.description: Colour used when the resolved value is absent from the map.

color.description: Resolves the row's accent colour per item, so colour carries meaning from the data rather than being fixed by the author.

status.description: an at-a-glance status indicator (a Font Awesome glyph) rendered top-right of the `card` rowVariant. Each field is a {dot.path} resolved per item; the raw-value -> glyph/colour mapping is computed server-side (jq in the RESTAction), so the widget stays strongly typed. E.g. a blueprint's CompositionDefinition Ready condition resolved to {readyIcon}/{readyColor}/{readyReason}.

icon.description: {dot.path} to the resolved Font Awesome icon name (e.g. {readyIcon})

bar.description: per-row horizontal Progress bar (the reconciliation-rail row): an antd Progress line whose percent + stroke colour are resolved per item

value.description: {dot.path} to the value the stroke colour is chosen from.

map.description: Maps a resolved value to a stroke colour token.

default.description: Stroke colour used when the resolved value is absent from the map.

color.description: Resolves the bar's stroke colour per item.

label.description: optional trailing {dot.path} label (e.g. the % text or 7/7)

variant.description: Bar style: `line` for a standalone progress line, `rail` for the denser reconciliation-rail treatment.

primaryText.description: How the resolved value is rendered: `text` verbatim, `datetime` as an absolute timestamp, `relative` as a time-ago.

secondaryText.description: How the resolved value is rendered: `text` verbatim, `datetime` as an absolute timestamp, `relative` as a time-ago.

subPrimaryText.description: How the resolved value is rendered: `text` verbatim, `datetime` as an absolute timestamp, `relative` as a time-ago.

subSecondaryText.description: How the resolved value is rendered: `text` verbatim, `datetime` as an absolute timestamp, `relative` as a time-ago.

formats.description: Per-field rendering applied after each {dot.path} resolves.

rowActions.description: per-row action controls rendered as a kebab (⋯) menu on each row; each entry references an action id from widgetData.actions and is fired with the row's data as the action payload (customPayload). Distinct from navigateTo (whole-row click).

actionId.description: id of an action defined in widgetData.actions to fire when this menu item is clicked

icon.description: optional Font Awesome icon name for the menu item

danger.description: render the menu item in a destructive (red) style

sseEndpoint.description: optional SSE endpoint to stream items from (Krateo extension)

maxItems.description: max items kept when streaming (Krateo extension, default 200)

actions.description: the actions of the widget (canonical map; see src/schemas/actions.schema.json). Referenced per-row by itemTemplate.rowActions.

rest.description: rest api call actions triggered by the widget

resourceRefId.description: the identifier of the k8s custom resource that should be represented

requireConfirmation.description: whether user confirmation is required before triggering the action

errorMessage.description: a message that will be displayed inside a toast in case of error

fanOutPath.description: name of an ARRAY field in the submitted values: the action fans out into ONE ordered write per element (for each write, that field is replaced by the single element before payload/payloadToOverride interpolation). The whole set is gated behind ONE aggregated blast-radius confirm and dispatched sequentially with stop-on-first-error and per-item results (W0-4 applySet semantics); onEventNavigateTo is not supported on a fan-out action

ops.description: ordered list of DISTINCT writes applied as ONE gated set (e.g. one Form submit creating a Role AND its RoleBinding): each op resolves its OWN resourceRefId (verb + path + payload base) and builds its OWN payload/payloadToOverride against the SAME submitted values. The whole set is gated behind ONE aggregated blast-radius confirm and dispatched sequentially with stop-on-first-error and per-item results (W0-4 applySet semantics). Mutually exclusive with fanOutPath; onEventNavigateTo is not supported on a multi-op action. The action's own top-level payload/payloadToOverride are IGNORED when ops is present and its top-level resourceRefId is ignored for dispatch (it must still name a valid resource ref — point it at the first op's)

resourceRefId.description: the identifier of the resource ref this op targets: its verb (must be mutating), path and payload base

payload.description: static payload sent with this op's request

payloadToOverride.description: list of this op's payload fields to override dynamically (values interpolate against the same submitted values as every other op)

name.description: name of the field to override

value.description: value to use for overriding the field

successMessage.description: a message that will be displayed inside a toast in case of success

onSuccessNavigateTo.description: url to navigate to after successful execution

onEventNavigateTo.description: conditional navigation triggered by a specific event

eventReason.description: identifier of the awaited event reason

url.description: url to navigate to when the event is received

timeout.description: the timeout in seconds to wait for the event

reloadRoutes.description: Re-fetch the route table before navigating. Set it when the action creates its own destination — publishing a new page, for example — so the route exists by the time the navigation happens.

loadingMessage.description: message to display while waiting for the event

headers.description: array of headers as strings, format 'key: value'

items.description: key and value as a single, example: 'x-custom-header: value'

payload.description: static payload sent with the request

payloadToOverride.description: list of payload fields to override dynamically

name.description: name of the field to override

value.description: value to use for overriding the field

display.description: Show the in-flight indicator. Set false to run the action without one.

loading.description: Whether this action shows an in-flight indicator while it runs.

display.description: Show the in-flight indicator. Set false to run the action without one.

loading.description: Whether this action shows an in-flight indicator while it runs.

path.description: the identifier of the route to navigate to

resourceRefId.description: the identifier of the k8s custom resource that should be represented

requireConfirmation.description: whether user confirmation is required before navigating

openDrawer.description: actions to open side drawer components

id.description: unique identifier for the drawer action

resourceRefId.description: the identifier of the k8s custom resource that should be represented

requireConfirmation.description: whether user confirmation is required before opening

title.description: title shown in the drawer header

display.description: Show the in-flight indicator. Set false to run the action without one.

loading.description: Whether this action shows an in-flight indicator while it runs.

openModal.description: actions to open modal dialog components

id.description: unique identifier for the modal action

resourceRefId.description: the identifier of the k8s custom resource that should be represented

requireConfirmation.description: whether user confirmation is required before opening

title.description: title shown in the modal header

display.description: Show the in-flight indicator. Set false to run the action without one.

loading.description: Whether this action shows an in-flight indicator while it runs.

customWidth.description: the custom width of the value, which should be used by setting the 'custom' value inside the 'size' property

size.description: sets the Modal size, 'default' is 520px, 'large' is 80% of the screen width, 'fullscreen' is 100% of the screen width, 'custom' should be used with the 'customWidth' property

watch.description: live-refresh watch: involvedObject(s) this widget is tied to (see src/schemas/watch.schema.json). A matching k8s event refetches the widget.

namespace.description: scope to a namespace; omit to match any

name.description: a specific object; omit to match any object of this kind ("GVR-level")

widgetData.description: The properties List renders. Where List wraps an antd component these are antd's own prop names, so antd's documentation for that component describes them.

allowed.description: Set server-side: whether the caller may perform this verb. False entries are stripped before the widget renders and are never authored by hand.

apiVersion.description: Group and version of the referenced resource, for example `widgets.templates.krateo.io/v1beta1`.

id.description: The author-chosen handle this widget uses to reference the resource, matching a resourceRefId in widgetData.

verb.description: HTTP verb used to resolve the reference. GET for a read; a mutating verb makes this a write the widget can dispatch.

items.description: One referenced resource. The widget addresses it by its `id`, never by name.

resourcesRefs.description: The resources this widget references by id. Each entry is resolved server-side and its endpoint handed to the widget; entries the caller may not read are removed before the widget renders, so a denied reference reads as absence rather than as an error.

name.description: Name of the RESTAction resource to call.

apiRef.description: Binds this widget to a RESTAction whose response feeds the widgetDataTemplate and resourcesRefsTemplate expressions. Omit it for a widget whose data is entirely static.

forPath.description: Dot-path inside widgetData whose value this expression replaces, for example `items[0].title`.

expression.description: A jq expression evaluated server-side against the apiRef response. Its result replaces the value at forPath.

widgetDataTemplate.description: Per-field overrides evaluated against the apiRef response, so one authored widget can render live cluster data. Each entry replaces one value inside widgetData.

iterator.description: A jq expression selecting the array in the apiRef response to iterate over.

apiVersion.description: Group and version of the referenced resource, for example `widgets.templates.krateo.io/v1beta1`.

id.description: The author-chosen handle this widget uses to reference the resource, matching a resourceRefId in widgetData.

payload.description: Body sent with a mutating verb. Ignored for a GET.

verb.description: HTTP verb used to resolve the reference. GET for a read; a mutating verb makes this a write the widget can dispatch.

template.description: The resourcesRefs entry emitted for each iterated element; its fields may interpolate that element.

resourcesRefsTemplate.description: Generates resourcesRefs entries from the apiRef response — one per element the iterator yields — so a widget can reference a list whose length it does not know when authored.

spec.description: The widget's contract: its own data, an optional binding to a RESTAction, the resources it references, and any templated overrides.
